newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers Turkey $100 mln in GSM-102 for FY97.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers Turkey $100 mln in GSM-102 for FY97.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Tuesday authorized $100 million in credit guarantees for sales of U.S. farm goods to Turkey under the Export Credit Guarantee Program (GSM-102) for fiscal 1997.

USDA said the commodities covered are solid wood products, wheat, wheat flour, semolina, rice, feedgrains, animal feed products, protein meal, breeder livestock, poultry breeder livestock, fish, vegetable oil, oilseeds, tallow, dairy products, meat, feeder cattle, cotton and planting seeds.
Sales must be registered by Sept. 30, 1997 with exports no later than Nov. 30 of that year.
